text: Bitcoin is down 2% while Ethereum has fallen 3.7%, signaling mild risk-off sentiment as altcoins underperform the major. The Fear & Greed index sits at 62 (Greed) but has dropped 9 points over the week, suggesting enthusiasm is cooling despite still-elevated volume of $88.6 trillion—a sign traders remain active but conviction is waning. Bitcoin dominance at 59.3% reflects a flight toward the largest asset, typical of consolidation phases where retail confidence softens.
